_meta.purpose: Hand-read corrections to the machine reading of the Diavgeia deadline-extension acts (khmdhs/extension_acts_loader.py). Every entry was read from the act's own operative part; the verbatim grant sentence is quoted. DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-21 (curation pass 1).

keys.area_dates: the date each named forest service was granted, when one act grants DIFFERENT dates per area — the machine keeps every date but not which service gets which; canonical registry names (khmdhs/data/forest_authorities.json)
keys.scope_auth: overrides the services an area act resolves to — used where the act names a directorate (Δ/νση Δασών Φθιώτιδας, Έβρου) standing for the contract's Δασαρχεία under it
keys.new_deadline: overrides the extracted deadline where the latest date in the operative part is not the grant (ΨΠΩΟ: a condition on the studies' approvals)
keys.per_area: overrides the per-area flag together with new_deadline

_meta.rule: Apply at load and on --reextract; a service name not in the registry or a date not in the act's own dates is refused.
